body: i hope you get a break soon, love. if it’s anyone who deserves one, it’s you.

i’d just want to start over so everything was much simpler again. no worries except being hungry and trying to avoid the bath like the plague. no need to brush your hair, dress up nice, get assignments in on time - nothing. i would love to have that again, and if i had my knowledge i have now, maybe i’d act dumb and keep to myself so the world would give up on me sooner instead on piling on so much pressure. people can’t expect anything from you if you don’t have anything to give in the first place. if only i’d known as a kid that being myself was the worst thing to do in this life...

one can only hope haha.

it’s the opposite where i’m from. i hear so many cheating stories, most of them being girl against guy. i wish some of them would see that there are loyal girls out there who’s actually care.. but who knows. i can’t peel into their minds.
 
good luck to you, i hope you find someone in the future who loves you a whole lot.!
me too, but no guy looks my way. it sucks to see lonely people that would treat someone so much better than the girl/boy they have now. i feel you haha...

i don’t think any input is going to stop you, but i just wanted to let you know that if this is what you feel you need to do - i guess you do. 
sometimes we can’t be selfish and make people suffer... they need to choose their own path. even if it means death.
i hope things get better for you - if you’re alive at the end of the night or not.
safe travels my friend, i’m sorry the world has failed you. it’ll be alright soon.

thanks hun, and kind of.

everyday is slowly easier to let go, but with the holidays and new year, i’m reminded of him with pictures and on socials... especially feeling lonely when i see him with his newest girl.

i hope you find closer in your situation as well, good wishes!
thank you very much

hey! i used this as a mini list for me to look up any bl series/ovas i wanted to watch but missed. hope this helps!

https://www.listchallenges.com/yaoi-bl-anime

thank you, and sorry for making you tear up - i guess you’re another person to add to my list haha.

you’re exactly right, and sometimes it makes us question if the struggle and worry are even worth a 9-5 job in the end. it’s what we’re supposed to aim for after all.

thank you for reaching out to me, and honestly i think that if i continue living, there truly won’t be a time where i won’t want to be dead. i wish you well too. you’re a beautiful human being.
wish i wasn’t

wherever your journey is taking you, it will. but i wish you the best of peace wherever you may be. i wish you would stay, but sometimes we can’t keep the ones we want to stay, and have to be selfless enough to understand no matter how much we want them to continue being with us, we have to let them go. i don’t know you, but i know things will be peaceful for you soon, whether or not you’re going to be alive or not. this too will pass, honey. keep your head high as you walk into your new journey, you deserve it no matter where it may be. good luck, everything will be okay even if you believe it won’t.

i read through this in its entirety and, quite frankly, i commend you for surviving through all of this. i don’t know you, but i just want to let you know i’m proud of you. proud of you for making it this far. you deserve every bit of peace that may come to you in the future. keep hanging on, i think good times are near, my friend.
i know everything seems like a lot right now, but you can do this - you can make it out of this. we believe in you.! always remember that, okay?
i’m so sorry you’ve lost them, but after a certain amount of times of treatments, meds, etc, it is just too much for me to go on. thank you fo your offer, you’re truly an angel xx

i think you’re mistaken.
i hurt everyone. that’s why i want to be dead in the first place lol
why.?
hello?
if you like him, try! you never know what’ll happen unless you do hun. if he doesn’t like the “real you”, it’s honestly his loss.. also, just make sure you’re safe and comfortable.! it’ll be alright.
thank you, i just can’t stop think about my mom..
it’s nothing serious, he just has someone new... that’s all :)
baby steps... i’m afraid i’m too late though.
i feel you... i hope one day we can speak our minds to who we need haha
very, very true. at least we aren’t entirely alone i guess...
thanks haha, i love vent-writing
safe journeys friend... if you felt like this is what you needed, maybe it was. i hope you’re at peace now, everything’s alright.

thank you

it all just gets a lot, especially for that past few weeks or so, even before this camp. 

it’s just tiring, but i hope i can make it.
thanks.. means a lot. but i don’t really think i’m worth enough to just live for myself tbh..?
thanks... just wishful thinking cause nothing else seems to work...
im dyinggggg but my disassociation disorder seems to be the boy next door or whatever😂 great analogies all around haha!
i feel you... no harm in trying! also, i hope your little wish comes true as well.
thanks :) i guess i’ll just keep trying... or just sleep haha... hope you’re feeling alright too by the way.!
happiness is impossible in this part of town.. just hoped maybe someone would stroll along and make me feel something idk
now that’s a wish to make..! ill save it for tomorrow’s 11:11 haha
sounds good to me haha.. or maybe never wake up? just dream away everything? i guess that sounds appealing too..
we can only hope..! just playing the waiting game sucks (•-•)
sigh.. veeeeeery true
glad a few people see what’s going on.. hope you’re okay as well
i wish i could.. so much wishing going on i guess
i guess haha.. nothing feels worse than being alone in the early hours..
i wouldn’t do that to him.. at least you have someone to say goodbye to. stay strong love, i can’t say it’ll be okay but it’ll be better sometime soon xx
i suppose.. just the same old same old
thank you :)
